name: ClipMyApp
description: Turns app screen recordings into short videos, memes, and carousels; MCP server and REST API let assistants create, edit, approve, and schedule posts behind a human review step.

skills.name: Generate Posts
skills.description: Turns a recording into short videos, memes, and carousels via generate_posts, using project hooks, memes, and audio tracks.

skills.name: Edit Drafts
skills.description: Applies exact edits to generated drafts and writes or updates your own posts with edit_post, write_own_post, and update_own_post.

skills.name: Review And Approval
skills.description: Routes drafts through a human review step with approve_post, reject_post, and rewrite_finished_post before anything publishes.

skills.name: Schedule Publishing
skills.description: Schedules approved posts to connected social accounts with schedule_post, bulk_schedule_posts, and cancel_scheduled_post.

skills.name: Media Import
skills.description: Brings in source footage by URL or direct upload using import_media_from_url, start_media_upload, and complete_media_upload.

skills.name: Account Inspection
skills.description: Reads projects, recordings, calendar, publishing rules, and analytics through list_projects, get_calendar, and get_analytics.
